preconditions.description: The number of queries Q is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each query line contains exactly three space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= 10**18 and 1 <= q <= 10**18 for line in stdin_lines[1:] for p, q in [(int(line.split()[1]), int(line.split()[2]))])
preconditions.description: The encoded parameters p and q in each query are between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.
The tree is initially rooted at node 1 with weight 0, and cnt starts at 1.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == sum(1 for line in stdin_lines[1:] if int(line.split()[0]) == 2)
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 2 queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.isdigit() for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a non-negative integer representing the maximum sequence length.

For each type 2 query, the output is the maximum length of a sequence starting at R, moving to ancestors, where the sum of weights does not exceed X, and for any consecutive nodes i (ancestor) and j (descendant) in the sequence, w[i] >= w[j] and no node k on the simple path between i and j has w[k] >= w[j].
